findings.highlight: I feel like I owe him now."
findings.evidenceJa: なんだかんだって世話やかれちまった」
findings.governingReading: Despite appearances, Shirou says Kirei ended up fussing over him or looking after him in one way or another.
findings.explanation: Kirei taking care of Shirou becomes Shirou owing him.

findings.highlight: "What did he do to you, Shirou!? Your wounds aren't fully healed yet. You know what will happen if you're reckless enough to repeat what happened last night!"
findings.evidenceJa: 「それで、何をされたのですかシロウ……！　貴方の傷はまだ完治してはいない。少しの油断で昨夜の繰り返しになるのだと、貴方自身も判っている筈です……！」
findings.governingReading: Saber warns that even slight carelessness could cause last night's near-fatal situation to recur.
findings.explanation: A little carelessness causing a repeat becomes Shirou recklessly repeating the event.

findings.highlight: Even her indignation is amusing, and my cheeks start burning.
findings.evidenceJa: そう抗議する顔すら新鮮で、つい頬が緩んでしまう。
findings.governingReading: Saber's indignant face is so fresh to Shirou that his expression involuntarily softens into another smile.
findings.explanation: Shirou's cheeks loosening into a smile becomes his cheeks burning.

findings.highlight: Saber flinches and takes a step back.
findings.evidenceJa: ざざ、と後ろに跳び退くセイバー。
findings.governingReading: She springs backward with a sustained shuffling sound after Shirou calls her properly a girl.
findings.explanation: Saber jumping backward becomes flinching and taking one step.

findings.highlight: "I can't tell if you're a busybody or a perfectionist."
findings.evidenceJa: 「—お人好しなんだか、完璧主義なんだかな」
findings.governingReading: Shirou wonders whether Saber is an お人好し—a kind, overly good-natured person—or a perfectionist.

findings.highlight: I have to make her a promise that I should have done from the beginning.
findings.evidenceJa: 交わすべきだった約束を、ここできちんと果たさないと。
findings.governingReading: Shirou thinks he must now properly fulfill the promise that should have been exchanged at the beginning.
findings.explanation: Fulfilling an overdue promise becomes doing a promise.
